text:
maria: quick heads-up — saturday 02:00 UTC we're doing a short rolling reboot in eu-central1 then us-east1 to apply NIC microcode + a small switch-fabric firmware flip. target: ~<2m per rack, staggered cohorts>

sam: timeframe? is this simultaneous across regions or staggered?

maria: staggered. start eu @ 02:00, wait 30m, then start us. cohorts = rack groups of ~12 nodes. cordon -> drain -> reboot -> uncordon.

kevin: FYI this will trigger kv-cache reseed on warmback. plan to run the priming job after uncordon for each cohort. expect ~3% extra burst capacity for ~10m per cohort. cost estimate ~+$1.1k for the window.

tia: can we exclude high-SLA dedicated pools? prefer non-dedicated first half.

maria: yes excluding dedicated pools (tag:deds=false). ops script will target labels `env=hosted,preemptible!=true` — double-checking selectors.

sam: ok. any canary? would like one rack cold start first.

maria: canary = pool calc-canary-1 (eu). manual verify after priming: run a quick gen test and embeddings baseline.

kevin: command for drain: `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=2m` . also will run `reseed-kvcache --pool calc-canary-1` after uncordon.

tia: monitoring hooks? want automatic rollback if p95 latency jumps >200ms for >3m.

maria: yes — hook added to maintenance runbook: if latency alert fires -> stop new cohorts, revert to fallback routing (route: cost-tier->fallback-small-model). cc @oncall.

deploy-bot: maintenance ticket created: INFR-2437. scheduled windows: eu-central1 2025-06-07T02:00Z, us-east1 2025-06-07T02:30Z. linked runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/INFR-2437

sam: communications — notify customers in premium and dedicated packages?

maria: yes, send automated notice to tenants with reserved capacity and premium SLA 24h prior. public status page banner 1h prior.

kevin: small ops note: nvme-backed ephemeral cleanup might prolong drain if disk scrub starts. add `--skip-drain-disk-scrub` in our helper to avoid extra wait. ops will run cleanup async after warmback.

tia: good. I'll prep dashboards: latency, token-per-second, kv-cache-miss-rate, and embedding queue depth. will attach perf baselines in the runbook.

maria: final checklist: 1) canary rack verify 2) priming job 3) monitor thresholds 4) cost-limiter in place 5) comms sent. volunteers for on-call pair?

sam: i'll take eu canary watch.

kevin: i'll run the priming job and cost-monitor.

maria: tia you'll own dashboards/alerts?

tia: on it.

maria: thanks team — will post a short post-mortem if any regressions. :thumbsup:
